preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 3 and 70, inclusive.
Each stone is initially located on a vertex labeled with an integer from 1 to n.
The matrix representing the colors of the diagonals is symmetric, with the main diagonal filled with '*'.

postconditions.description: Output is -1 if it is impossible to move stones to vertices 1, 2, and 3.
Output is a positive integer representing the minimal number of moves required to place stones on vertices 1, 2, and 3.

postconditions.expression: all(move[0] in stone_positions and move[1] not in stone_positions for move in moves)
postconditions.description: Each move is from a stone position to a free vertex, and the move is valid according to the game rules.
